questions.question: Identify the correct form of the verb in the following sentence: 'Had he known the truth, he ________ the decision differently.'

Which of the following sentences correctly uses the subjunctive mood after 'if' in a hypothetical situation? 

Options refer to the following scenario: 

If I ________ the results of my research, I would have published it last week.'
Select the correct option to complete the cleft sentence: 'It was not until she had finished her thesis that the researcher realised the data was incomplete.'
options: The researcher realised the data was incomplete only when she had finished her thesis.
The researcher did not realise the data was incomplete until she had finished her thesis.
The researcher realised the data was incomplete after she had finished her thesis.
The researcher did not realise the data was incomplete because she had finished her thesis.
questions.answer: The researcher realised the data was incomplete only when she had finished her thesis.

questions.question:
Which of the following sentences correctly demonstrates ellipsis (omission of words understood from context)? 

Context: 

'I am sure he is competent. 

I am sure he is not honest.'
options: He is competent, but he is not honest.
He is competent, but not honest.
He is competent, but that he is not honest.
questions.answer: He is competent, but not honest.
